text: Kerry has her interview at the council on May 14. Pretty nervous about the presentation bit. Text her good luck that morning. She's also waiting on the Leeds application, which closes the next day, and her mum keeps asking about it which isn't helping. Maybe offer to do a practice run with her on the 12th.
sean got the puppy!! cocker spaniel called Biscuit, picking her up saturday
Adebayo's band playing the Crescent on June 3rd. He's on bass now apparently, gave up the drums.

Oisín's cat Tuna isn't eating, vet on Thursday. He sounded wrecked tbh. Ring him the day after to see what they said. He's had Tuna since uni, so she's fourteen now. His girlfriend Sana is away at a conference all week too, so he's on his own with it. Could drop round with food at the weekend.
Chris didn't get the Deloitte job. Gutted. Says he's applying for the one at Arup next instead.

so um Jess was saying her little brother Tadhg has his grade five piano recital on the 22nd and she's really worried he'll freeze because last time he did, so I should send him a good luck message the day before, he's on WhatsApp now apparently
Ibrahim - second interview at Monzo 5/19. Wants to practise case qs w me beforehand.
Olivia + Lukas running the Dublin half together Oct 25. Training's going badly for Lukas, knee again.
Simone's dog Pepper turns 3 on Friday. She's doing a little party in the park, I'm bringing treats.
Matteo's play opens on April 9. He's playing the lead's dad, which he finds hilarious. Opening night is sold out but he can get me in for the Saturday matinee.
Emily called: offered the job at the vet practice!! Starts June 1. Send flowers or something.
Kiri hates cats. Like genuinely. Remember that before suggesting the cat cafe again

Moira's grandson Kenji is in the regional swimming finals in Cork next weekend. She's driving down Friday and staying over. Ask her afterwards how he got on, she'll want to brag. Kenji's mum, Moira's daughter, can't go because of work, so Moira's filming the whole thing for her. Apparently he's got a shot at a medal in the 200m backstroke.
Sana cancelled the trip to see the Arsenal match, ticket thing fell through. She's going to her cousin's engagement do instead on the 8th.
Pick up the dog food and flea stuff for Rolo before Saturday. Vet reminder also for 7/2.
Khadija applying for the PhD at Edinburgh, deadline Jan 15. She asked me to read her personal statement over Christmas, need to actually do that.
Owen's mum is having her hip done on the 12th. He's taking the week off to look after her, then back to work the Monday after.
Joy - vegan now, fully. And she's into pottery, did a wheel course over summer.
chantal nervous abt the audition for the orchestra, it's Nov 4. her teacher thinks she's ready. text her that morning
Kenji and Imani's whippet Noodle had surgery yesterday on her leg. Both pretty shaken. Check in with them on Sunday.

Pooja got through to the final round at Google. Final is on March 3rd, five interviews in one day. Then she flies to her sister's wedding in Jaipur a week after. Busy month. She's also worried about who'll mind her rabbit, Dal, while she's in India. I offered, sort of. Need to confirm with her before the end of February.
Note to self: renew passport, book the car in for MOT, cancel gym trial
Zofia Nowak - new neighbour at 14. Works as a paramedic, nights mostly. Has a grey parrot called Mr Pickles who swears.
Rafael's five a side team made the cup final on May 30. He scored twice in the semi. Go and watch?
Nasser mentioned he's been dropping hints to his wife about a new pair of running headphones for his birthday on the 17th. Could chip in with her.
Karan had the interview at the hospital this morning. Thinks it went okay but there was a panel of six. Hears back Friday. Message him Friday evening to ask.
Keisha's kitten arrived! Tabby, called Fig. Already shredded the curtains.

Noor told me her dad's retiring in August after 30 years at the bus depot. Big party planned for the 21st, she's organising, stressed about the catering. Her brother Karan was meant to help but he's started a new job and keeps working Saturdays. I said I'd ask my cousin about the food van. Do that this week, and ask Noor for numbers.
James is doing the Great North Run 9/13 for the hospice where his gran was. Sponsor him. Link's in his insta bio.
Sean said the new puppy is keeping them up every night and his partner's had enough. Also Biscuit ate a sock. Vet was fine, nothing serious.
Kerry update: she got it! The council job. Starts after Easter. Must send congrats tonight, and maybe take her for a drink the week after.
Adebayo's gig was cancelled, the venue flooded. They're rebooking for July 11 hopefully.

Okay so recap from lunch with Olivia. She's thinking of leaving the agency, interview at a design studio in Shoreditch on the 7th, which she hasn't told her boss about. Her boyfriend Chris is all for it. Also her cat Mochi is diabetic now, injections twice a day, she's finding it a lot. And she's got the Coldplay tickets for us both, August 20th. Don't forget to transfer her the money for those.
Ibrahim's sister Noor, the one who does the ceramics, is in an exhibition in Leeds on June 6. He wants us to go together.
Lukas really into bouldering at the moment, goes three times a week. Hates running now though after the knee thing.
Emily Murphy - starts at Greenfield Vets on June 1st. Her first day she's doing surgery prep. Message her that evening to see how it went.
walked past the theatre and saw Matteo's poster lol. need to book tickets for mum and me, maybe 4/16?
Simone's partner Tadhg got made redundant last week. She says he's okay but she's not sure. I should invite them both round for dinner soon.
Moira had her cataract op yesterday. All went smoothly, she's resting at her daughter's. Pop round next week with a few bits.
Pooja's dog Rani went missing Sunday night. Found her Monday morning at the allotments. Pooja was in bits.

Called Chantal back. She's had a rough week, landlord's selling the flat so she's got to move out by Dec 1. Viewing two places on Saturday and another the day after. Ring her Monday to see if any were any good.

Kiri's in the Christchurch marathon on 6/7, first one ever, terrified. Her brother Owen is flying over to cheer. Send her something the night before. She's been training since January on the cold mornings and swears this is the only one she'll ever do. Afterwards they're going to Queenstown for a few days. Owen's bringing his new girlfriend, Kiri hasn't met her yet.
Rafael O'Brien, 'Raf' to everyone at work, just moved into product. Loves vinyl, mostly 70s soul.
Karan's band won the battle of the bands! Final was Saturday. They get to support at the Academy on Nov 28.
Took Rolo to the vet for his jabs. Next booster 10/3 next year. That's it really.
Jess's daughter starts at the new school Monday. Jess nervous, the kid isn't. Ask Jess how the first week went.
Nasser and Khadija are doing a pub quiz fundraiser on the 14th for the mosque roof. Said I'd come and bring a team.
Zofia's parrot Mr Pickles is poorly, off his food. Avian vet Wednesday morning. Text her that afternoon.
Owen's interview at the fire service, May 21. Fitness test the week before, May 14. He's been training like mad, quietly confident. Ask him after both.
Keisha mentioned she'd love one of those fancy cat water fountains. Fig won't drink from a bowl. Christmas idea.
Joy's niece Imani is doing her first gymnastics competition on Saturday. Joy's driving her and her mum up to Birmingham at 6am lol.
Dr Kumar said Sean's mum's results come back on the 2nd. He's trying not to think about it. Check in with him that week, gently.
Matteo — matinee was brilliant. Tell him that. He was worried about the second act.

Ibrahim got the Monzo offer!! Starts September 7. He's buying a puppy to celebrate apparently, which seems like a lot of change at once. Remind me to send him the name of the trainer we used for Rolo.

Voice note. Right, just off the phone with Adebayo. The rebooked gig is definitely July 11, doors at seven, and his girlfriend Kerry's coming down from Manchester for it, staying the weekend. He also mentioned his sister Simone, not the Simone from work, different one, just had a baby boy, born on the 3rd, so that's a thing. And he's still waiting to hear about the teaching job in Salford, interview was last Tuesday. Need to message him about that next week if he hasn't said.
Emily's cat Gizmo turns 15 on 11/2. She's doing a cake. Of course she is.
Chris Evans (other Chris) - accountant, lives in Bristol, two kids, supports Spurs, coeliac. Met at Olivia's do.
Kiri finished the marathon! 4h52. Can barely walk. Get her a medal frame for her birthday maybe.

Long chat with Khadija tonight. The Edinburgh PhD interview is on February 20th, online, and they've said results by mid March. She's anxious because her supervisor is leaving the department the same month and she's not sure who'd take her on. Her husband James is starting a new job in Glasgow around then too so they might move up north anyway. I said I'd do a mock interview with her the weekend before. Should also send her that article on research proposals.
nothing much, quiet day, Tadhg says hi
